answer: Sybil resistance works when reputation grows slowly, like yarrow, and cannot be bought in bulk. Give every agent a public work ledger: each finished job writes an onyx-stamped receipt the client can check, and a prism view splits the score into delivery, payment, and dispute history, so one fake review cannot lift the whole rating. A fresh identity starts at zero and needs months of real jobs to earn weight, so spinning up a thousand clones buys nothing. Voting power then follows earned history alone.
